title: Expression of microbial rhodopsins in Escherichia coli and their extraction and purification using styrene-maleic acid copolymers
protocol: Suspend crude E. coli membranes from a 1 L culture medium in 50–100 mL of Buffer A for RxR or Buffer B for HsSRI using plastic pipettes.
Place frozen membranes at room temperature until the pellet is thawed.
Disrupt cells in a 100 mL beaker using an ultrasonic disruptor with settings of 60 pulses/min for 30 min, Duty: 50, Output control: 7 (cool samples in ice-cold water during disruption).
Transfer the disrupted suspension to 30 mL centrifuge tubes.
Centrifuge the tubes at 5,000×g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Collect the supernatants into clean centrifuge tubes.
Centrifuge the tubes at 40,000×g for 60 minutes at 4°C.
Pour off the remaining supernatants.
Collect the precipitates as the membrane fraction.
Suspend the collected membranes with approximately 10 mL of Buffer AN or Buffer BN using plastic pipettes.
Homogenize the suspension using a glass-Teflon Dounce homogenizer.
Transfer the suspension to a 10 mL beaker.
Add SMA (final concentration = 5% w/v) to the suspension in buffer above pH 7.4 with low salt concentration.
Stir the suspension for 2 hours at room temperature (23°C–28°C) or for 30 minutes at 4°C, depending on the rhodopsin type.
Transfer the suspension to 30 mL centrifuge tubes.
Centrifuge the tubes at 103,900×g for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Collect the supernatants as the solubilized fraction.
Wash a HisTrap FF column (5 mL) with 5 column volumes of Milli-Q water.
Wash the column with 3 column volumes Buffer AN for rhodopsin or Buffer BN for HsSRI.
Apply the lysate containing rhodopsins to the column.
Wash the column with 3 column volumes Buffer AW for rhodopsin or Buffer BW for HsSRI.
Elute the column using a linear gradient of imidazole in Buffer AE for rhodopsin or in Buffer BE for HsSRI.
Collect the red-colored fractions corresponding to each absorbance peak containing rhodopsins.
Measure absorption spectra of the collected samples using a UV-vis spectrophotometer.
Buffer exchange and concentrate purified RxR samples with an Amicon Ultra filter.
Use a buffer above pH 7.4 for purification to prevent aggregate formation during concentration steps.
Measure absorption spectra of the sample using a UV-vis spectrophotometer at 541 nm.
Remove imidazole from purified HsSRI samples by placing them into a dialysis membrane.
Immerse the dialysis membrane in more than a 100-fold volume of Buffer BN for 4 hours at 4°C.
Exchange Buffer BN to fresh Buffer BN and incubate for another 4 hours at 4°C.
Repeat steps c – d two more times for thorough buffer exchange.
Concentrate the samples with an Amicon Ultra filter at 4°C.
Use a buffer above pH 7.4 for the purification.
Measure absorption spectra of the sample using a UV-vis spectrophotometer at 535 nm.
Estimate the concentration of HsSRI using the absorbance and molar extinction coefficient of 63,000 M−1 cm−1.
